areaNote: OSM maps BSU as two outlines either side of the rail line: West Campus way/311754679 (Pope, Scott, Woodward; Maxwell Library, Mohler-Faria Science, Boyden, Harrington, Rondileau Student Union, Tillinghast) and East Campus way/29694355 (Shea/Durgin, Miles, DiNardo, Crimson, Stonehouse, Weygand, Great Hill; Moakley, Hart, Burnell, East Campus Commons, Tinsley Center), with no relation joining them. Both are used: area.osm is West Campus and area.also adds East Campus, and the bbox spans both (centre about 41.9883, -70.9661).
noCodes: No public building-code list: BSU's course search (bridgew.edu/bsu-course-search) shows rooms as codes such as DMF342 and HRG with no legend, the campus map (bridgew.edu/about-us/campus-map) lists buildings by name and street address only, and the campus navigation guide PDF numbers buildings 1-40 without codes (checked 2026-11-26).
